decisions.reason: As a flagship launch close to the established offer with high public commitment, escalation of commitment leads management to persist despite any disappointing results.
Although less central, the firm has invested resources and publicly launched this service, so management will likely justify and retain it.
Given its flagship status, centrality to the announced direction, and visible commitment, sunk costs strongly favor keeping the portal.
The app builds on established capabilities and represents a committed investment, so management will likely persist rather than drop it.
